name: Open Local Repo
description: Resolves a name or partial path to a local repo under configured search roots and surfaces the command to open it in the configured editor.

searchRoots.label: Search Roots
searchRoots.description: Directories TPM searches for a matching repo name, comma-separated. First match wins.

fuzzyMatch.label: Fuzzy Match
fuzzyMatch.description: When on, matches input as a case-insensitive substring of directory names. Off requires an exact match. Default on.

openCommand.label: Open Command
openCommand.description: Command TPM suggests for opening the resolved path (e.g. code, code-insiders, cursor). Any command accepting a path argument works; it runs after the user confirms.

triggerPhrases.label: Trigger Phrases
triggerPhrases.description: Comma-separated list of substring patterns TPM watches for. Matched case-insensitively. Tune to fit phrasing patterns.
triggerPhrases.default: open repo, open in vscode, take me to, open project, switch to repo

onMultipleMatches.label: On Multiple Matches
onMultipleMatches.description: How multiple fuzzy matches are handled. ask (default): lets the user pick. first: silently takes the first match. refuse: asks for a more specific name.
